title.value: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance
title.justification: This was directly taken from the article's title, indicating the focus of research on digital innovations and climate governance.
title.quote: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance

extractions.description: This paper explores the role of digitally-enabled innovations in transforming climate governance. It categorizes digital strategies into data mobilization, optimization of existing strategies, incentivizing and automating behavioural change, and enhancing participation, examining their alignment with governance challenges in the context of climate mitigation.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on how digital technologies are leveraged to transform climate governance, which is a key theme in sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: ...we seek to explore the potential of transformations in and of governance regimes... for societies to transition....

primary_category.justification: The paper discusses digitally-enabled initiatives that aim to influence climate governance for climate mitigation, with a specific focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions and enhancing climate policies.
primary_category.quote: This work provides a first step towards understanding how digitally-enabled initiatives are contributing to re-imagining climate governance...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper delves into how digital technologies like AI, satellite, and sensors are utilized for environmental data, indirectly tying into climate science aspects.
secondary_categories.quote: Satellite, drone imagery, and remote sensing help monitor environmental conditions and are leveraged to provide support for different climate initiatives...

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper emphasizes data mobilization and optimization strategies based on digital technologies aiding in better decision-making relevant to climate governance, hence fitting into monitoring and reporting.
primary_sub_category.quote: Data mobilization (i.e. to strengthen decision-making) initiatives strive to provide more accurate, comprehensive, or easily accessible data to inform evidence-based decisions.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The focus on data mobilization and technological application for greenhouse gases reduction resonates with methods to track and measure GHGs.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: machine learning helps to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in various ways including through better forecasting, prediction, and efficiency gains...

applications.value: Use of AI and machine learning to optimize existing climate strategies
applications.justification: AI and machine learning are highlighted as tools for enhancing decision-making in climate governance and reducing GHG emissions.
applications.quote: ...the application of machine learning, a subset of artificial intelligence... has been recorded across a diverse range of sectors...

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories adequately cover the aspects discussed in the paper.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories match well with the paper's focus areas of monitoring, reporting, and verification.
